notes: Novo login com Google: agora podes entrar com Discord ou com Google (com o mesmo email entras na mesma conta). Contas novas ja nao criam um perfil sozinhas: escolhes tu o nome e o avatar. Corrigido: temporadas recem-estreadas (ex.: Black Clover 2nd Season) podiam nao mostrar fontes porque o Kitsu ainda nao as tinha ligado ao MyAnimeList.
notesEn: New Google sign-in: you can now log in with Discord or Google (using the same email takes you to the same account). New accounts no longer create a profile automatically: you pick the name and avatar. Fixed: newly released seasons (e.g. Black Clover 2nd Season) could show no sources because Kitsu had not linked them to MyAnimeList yet.
